definitions.full: H7283. ragash [ רָגַשׁ ] verb be in tumult or commotion (Arabic make a vehement noise ; Biblical Aramaic Aramaic רְגַשׁ , be disturbed, in tumult ( ᵑ7 Ithpe`el often for הָמָה , as Psa 46:6 , שָׁאָה Isa 17:12 f.; for חָמוֺן ibid .); but Syriac usually perceive , so Late Hebrew Hiph`il, but Hithpa`el fall stormily upon ); — Qal Perfect 3plural Psa 2:1 רָֽגְשׁוּ why do the nations throng tumultuously ?
